steps.text: 4:45 A.M. \ Clear
L.G.D. Headquarters Rooftop Ruins, Upper Lungmen

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, I believe Amiya is right next to you. Can you hear me?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, Chief Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Very well then.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I must apologize, leader of Rhodes Island. Though I can risk sending the L.G.D. deep into enemy territory, I can't risk bringing any more players into this game.

options: The situation out there is already chaotic.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Beneath this entire land lies an invisible, yet intricate net.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No single city can break free from this net of conspiracy and intrigue - and especially not Lungmen, as it is situated in the midsts of giants.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Perhaps you already know this, perhaps you don't. Nevertheless, I have to take all these factors into consideration.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Chief Wei, you should have shared this information with us if you wanted our mission to progress more smoothly.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At least, you should have told me.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I must apologize yet again, Miss Amiya. From my position, I simply cannot disclose all our intel.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: If you were standing in my shoes, you would have made the same decision.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: What happened in the Chernobog ruins was a pity, but at least you achieved something.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You used us to draw Reunion's attention.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No, the L.G.D. was right there with you.

options: You used all of us as bait.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He planned for all this a long time ago.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Reunion's infiltration only deepens as time passes, so he had to quickly make a decision.

options: At the most crucial moment, when Reunion was most vulnerable...
Rhodes Island was made to draw their attention.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He led Reunion to believe that the L.G.D. had been separated—

options: ...and fooled them into thinking that Lungmen was undefended.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Hah, well said, Dr. {@nickname}! Chief, of course you'd need us to hold Reunion back. The more the better, right?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: When the lurking Reunion saw Lungmen in such a state, there's no way they wouldn't spring at the opportunity.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: And as soon as they began to emerge from their lairs, then BAM! Lungmen's elite forces would be waiting for them, seemingly out of nowhere.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: How long have you been concealing Lungmen's power? Did you already start preparing for this after the Chernobog incident?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Lungmen kept you safe, and helped you return to a position that could maximize your value.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: You left Amiya to die back there in the middle of so many enemies. What kind of 'position' are you talking about?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I just hope that Rhodes Island can understand that we all have to face this difficult situation together.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Blaze, Dr. {@nickname}, it's fine.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Miss Swire helped us to defeat Reunion's forces, together. Lungmen did not abandon us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (We don't have any proof.)

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Tch...

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Our agreement is still valid. No matter what happened during the process, only the end result can satisfy me.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: No matter what happened.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname} of Rhodes Island, I believe I made myself clear the last time we met.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You do not have a choice in this matter. But at least you can choose how you eliminate your enemies.

options: I don't believe you or the snake oil you peddle.
Nobody will happily smile and go on their way after being deceived.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Isn't that for the best?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We should all stay alert. Nobody should let their guard down when we are facing a common enemy.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Your vigilance can keep you from falling into a trap.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Listen, Dr. {@nickname}—

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...We may not be friends yet, but at least we are not enemies.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: So, silence is your answer.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: A fine display of judgment. You would hide your weaknesses while pressing your advantages.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Rhodes Island indeed is a powerful partner. You have earned my recognition from this incident.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But, this comes on the condition that our relationship is still a partnership, not a statement of the status between illegal Infected and local authorities.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I do not intend to fool anyone.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Though, objectively speaking, I may well have fooled Reunion.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But none of that can be proven. Reunion may also have access to our secrets.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: We can only hope to destroy them before they come to grasp our strategies.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: So, does this goal motivate you at all?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Miss Amiya, Dr. {@nickname}, the cooperation between us has not ended yet.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: A counterattack is imminent. We will demonstrate Lungmen's stature, wisdom, and unity to them.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: If possible, I would also like to witness Rhodes Island's professionalism, resolve, and bravery.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: In fifteen minutes, Madam Ch'en will return to fight at your side.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mister Wei, I hope you don't forget what you just said.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Because Rhodes Island will not.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Naturally.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Blaze, Dr. {@nickname}, let's go.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Ah, by the way, Madam Ch'en, where's Inspector Hoshiguma? I don't see her around. Is she... all right?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: She had some minor injuries, nothing serious.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Oh, I see...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Madam Ch'en, Rhodes Island can also give you a checkup and provide some quick treatment if needed.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: No thanks.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You don't have to worry about anything, our medical procedures are completely confidential.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: A little bit of elbow grease is good enough.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm... If you insist, then I won't force you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In that case, I'll see you later then, Madam Ch'en.
5:00 A.M. \ Clear
Chief's Office, Upper Lungmen

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Chief Wei, how was everything on your end?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Good, of course. Otherwise, I wouldn't have time to chat with you here.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Did they agree to slow down the operation?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Of course, but there is a time limit.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Today, and tomorrow. If Reunion is still not contained after two days, you know what will happen.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Only two days?! That's not enough time! I can't—

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Two days and nights are already too generous. In comparison, I will only give you one day.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: One day?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I want you to take care of everything within a day.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Chief Wei, if they can help us, we can get rid of Reunion within hours. Wouldn't that minimize our losses?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That's not important. Lungmen should be able to handle its own problems, once and for all. That is our first principle.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That is what we need to demonstrate to them. So, everyone, get moving.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Go, Madam Ch'en. It is time to show Reunion some Lungmen hospitality.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Chief Wei, I do have one question. Even if you can't answer right now, I hope you can give me a reasonable guess after everything is over.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You may ask.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: This is supposed to be Reunion's all-out attack. In that case, why has their leader, Talulah, not appeared in Lungmen?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I thought things were progressing smoothly. Why are you frowning, then?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Have we received any response from Ursus?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Still nothing.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And we still can't get in contact with Speaker Witte?

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Unfortunately, our messenger hasn't even been able to meet him.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: By the looks of things, the Ursus Empire is completely opaque.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Fumizuki, I have a premonition. That this whole thing is just the start of something much bigger.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: The last time I heard you say that was many years ago.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: When did I say that? I've completely forgotten why I would say something like that.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: That was right after we first met. Are you saying that you've forgotten about everything that's ever happened between us?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: N-no way! How could I! I just can't remember most things apart from our time together.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Nice try, you sweet-talker. Unfortunately, this isn't something you'll be able to forget.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: You said this to my face twenty years ago... that if we lost, this city would be under a different name, and become just another stepping stone on the path to Ursus hegemony.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: If we had lost, you wouldn't be the one sitting here. He would.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Duke of Kashchey.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Alas, poor Tal. Don't you think she reminds us of him?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: But he's already dead.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Killed by Talulah herself.
